highlights: Volume and brightness controls redesigned, with the theme archetype architecture behind them.
A semantic button design system, plus opt-in desktop session integration from Settings.
The audio visualiser is driven by the real sink monitor with adaptive AGC and transient beat detection.

sections.title: Controls
items: Volume and brightness controls share one layout instead of two divergent sliders.
The visualizer switcher uses a dedicated equalizer icon and the speaker glyph was corrected.

sections.title: Integration
items: Desktop session entries are offered from Settings rather than installed silently.
Hyprland sessions no longer get KWin's screenshot authorization entry.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Buttons no longer clip on hover in the settings navigation and lists.
Preview capture restores its KWin ScreenShot2 authorization entry by itself.
